subject: PO prerequisites, invoice staging & pricing-floor proposal for pilot engagement
messages:
From: Kelsey Tran <kelsey.tran@healthwave.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: procure@healthwave.com
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO requirements and invoice cadence for the Q4 pilot

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is excited to run a small pilot in Q4. Procurement asked that I confirm a couple of constraints before we move to SOW/PO:

- We need to issue a Purchase Order to start (their standard PDF attached).
- Our AP requires a PO to include: buyer legal entity, PO number, itemized line descriptions, GL code, and vendor remit-to details.
- Preferred invoice cadence is biweekly or monthly (they've flagged weekly as a processing burden). Would you support biweekly invoices for pilot spend?
- Net terms: standard for us is Net45 for pilots, but we could consider Net30 with an early-pay discount.
- Do you have a minimum pricing floor or a pilot discount for limited usage?

Can you send back a quick note with the PO fields you need, the pricing for a 3-month pilot (estimated $25k total), and any required lead time for invoice runs?

Thanks — I'll loop in AP if we have alignment.

Kelsey
Head of Procurement, HealthWave

Attachment: HealthWave_PO_Template.pdf (PDF, 125KB)

From: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
To: Kelsey Tran <kelsey.tran@healthwave.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO requirements and invoice cadence for the Q4 pilot

Hi Kelsey —

Appreciate the detail. Quick answers below and a short proposal attached.

PO fields we require (minimum): vendor legal name (Redwood Inference, Inc.), remit-to address, PO number, billing contact email, SKU/line description that maps to: "Inference compute + usage" and the rate card reference. If you can include a GL code column that’s helpful but not mandatory — we can map on our side if needed.

Invoice cadence: biweekly is fine for the pilot. Our standard billing system supports monthly, biweekly, or weekly runs; biweekly will increase unit processing overhead slightly but we can absorb it for pilots.

Net terms & pricing-floor: for pilots we typically offer a 10% pilot discount off list, but we maintain a pricing floor to preserve unit economics. For the $25k 3-month pilot I ran two options in the attached spreadsheet:

- Option A (preferred): Pilot discount 10%, Net30, biweekly invoices. No up-front.
- Option B (finance needs): Pilot discount 7%, Net45, biweekly invoices, with a 1-month pre-authorized charge or PO-backed hold (applies only to first invoice).

If you confirm which option HealthWave prefers, we can prep an SOW and sign via DocuSign. Also attaching a short SOW draft that pins deliverables and acceptance criteria.

Cc’ing Vanessa (Customer Success) to confirm milestone/acceptance language.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_pricing_breakdown_Q4_pilot.xlsx (XLSX, 42KB); SOW-RW-HealthWave-Q4-pilot.docx (DOCX, 60KB)

Cc: Kelsey Tran <kelsey.tran@healthwave.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO requirements and invoice cadence for the Q4 pilot

Thanks Dylan — and hi Kelsey.

From CS ops perspective, we recommend Option B as the smoother onboarding path for procurement teams that insist on Net45: the 1-month pre-authorized charge protects Redwood on initial usage while we establish billing integrations, and HealthWave gets the longer pay window they prefer. Operational notes:

- We'll accept your PO as long as the PO includes the PO number and the buyer legal entity. Add the GL code if your AP needs it; otherwise we'll map to our internal GL.
- Biweekly invoices: please confirm the exact cut windows (we typically cut on 1st/16th but can align to your payroll cycle if needed).
- Please keep SOW acceptance criteria to one primary technical contact + one business approver to avoid gating.

If Kelsey is aligned we'll ask Finance to prep the DocuSign flow and routing.

Vanessa Ortiz
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Kelsey Tran <kelsey.tran@healthwave.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO requirements and invoice cadence for the Q4 pilot

Thanks Dylan and Vanessa — that makes sense. A couple follow-ups from AP:

1) Can Redwood accept Net45 for the pilot if we add a one-time PO note that authorizes the first invoice to be processed within 5 business days of activation? The note would read: "PO authorizes first invoice immediate processing; subsequent invoices Net45."
2) Our AP prefers monthly invoices for vendor consolidation. Biweekly is workable but would require an internal mapping. If we do monthly, can Redwood provide an invoice break-down file (CSV) that lists line items and usage windows so our ledger team can allocate costs across GL codes?
3) If we accept Option B (7% discount + pre-authorized charge), can you indicate how the pricing floor will apply if we exceed the $25k estimate? We want a defined de-escalation path if usage grows.

I can loop in procurement_ops@healthwave.com if needed.

Kelsey

> Attachment: (none)

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Kelsey Tran <kelsey.tran@healthwave.com>, dylan_brooks@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO requirements and invoice cadence for the Q4 pilot — finance confirmation

Hi Kelsey — Ben from Finance here. Quick confirmation on the ask and the compromise we can accept:

- We can accept your PO with Net45 on a pilot under the following two conditions (pick one):
  a) Provide a one-time pre-authorization for the first invoice equal to the estimated first-month spend (we will only capture if invoice is unpaid after 30 days).
  b) Provide an approved PO that includes the special note Dylan suggested: "PO authorizes first invoice immediate processing; subsequent invoices Net45."

- Invoice cadence: we will support monthly billing as requested. For monthly invoices we will attach a per-invoice CSV with itemized usage (columns: invoice_period_start, invoice_period_end, sku, quantity, unit_rate, line_total) to satisfy your ledger team.

- Pricing floor and overage: pilot discount applies to the agreed estimate period. If cumulative spend exceeds the $25k estimate by more than 20% in a single month, Redwood reserves the right to re-evaluate the rate card. In practice we will provide 30 days notice and propose either a blended overage rate or a tiered discount adjustment. We'll include clear language in the SOW.

Next steps: if you can return the PO with PO number + either pre-auth or the special note, we'll send the DocuSign SOW and finalize implementation dates.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: DocuSign link to SOW: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc-123-rtx
